titleRu: Пастор ICGC из Бельгии рукоположил принцессу Аботаки
summary: A 44-year-old Reverend Minister of the International Central Gospel Church (ICGC), Rev. Richard Tagoe, has been enstooled Amanonehene of Abotakyi in the Akuapem Traditional Area of the Eastern Region, with a pledge to mobilise diaspora support and attract investment for the town’s development. The businessman, who lives in Belgium, assumes the traditional title Nana Ohene Tagoe I. The Amanonehene title is intended to promote the welfare of indigenes living abroad and mobilise their support for development projects in the town. Following the traditional rites, Nana Ohene Tagoe I was carried shoulder-high and paraded through the principal streets of Abotakyi amid cheers, drumming and dancing.

De acordo com o Posto de Bombeiro Comunitário de Candói, nove pessoas ficaram feridas e foram encaminhadas para hospitais da região. ✅ Siga o canal do g1 Paraná no WhatsApp Entre os feridos, estão o motorista do caminhão, o motorista e um passageiro do carro, além de seis passageiros do ônibus. titleRu: Africa Amusement & Attractions Expo 2026: индустрия развлечений, парков и аттракционов встречается в Рабате
summary: Du 21 au 24 octobre 2026, la capitale marocaine accueillera l’Africa Amusement & Attractions Expo (AAAEXPO 2026), un rendez-vous international dédié à l’industrie des loisirs, des parcs et des attractions. Plus de 100 exposants internationaux issus de plus de 20 pays sont attendus pour cette rencontre qui réunira des professionnels africains et internationaux du secteur. Rabat s’apprête à devenir, le temps de cet événement, un carrefour d’échanges et d’opportunités pour les acteurs de l’industrie des loisirs et du divertissement.
